verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Temporal Client can send Signals to running Workflow Executions. Temporal also orchestrates work across 'any length of time' with durable resume, which implies a workflow can wait durably for external human input delivered via a Signal. However, no cited doc describes a human-approval or wait-for-input pattern, and as Workflows-as-Code (not no-code) any such pause must be written by developers rather than set up by an ops user. Missing for 10: explicit docs on waiting for a signal or human-in-the-loop approval, any UI or CLI flow for an ops user to approve or provide input, independent hands-on corroboration.
